summary: Conquer the galaxy in this premium 3D RTS game.
description:
Command your mechanized army to victory in MechCom 3 - 3D RTS! Dive into a deep real-time strategy experience where you'll build sprawling bases, harvest vital resources, and deploy devastating mechs to conquer the Sigma Galaxy. This highly anticipated sequel delivers the classic RTS action you crave with exciting new mechanics and stunning improvements.

In the 22nd century, powerful corporations clash for control of the resource-rich Sigma Galaxy. As a skilled commander, choose your allegiance and lead your forces in a dynamic campaign for galactic domination. Will you outmaneuver your rivals and claim the galaxy's riches?

Looking for a true RTS challenge? MechCom 3 delivers:

* Deep Strategic Gameplay: Construct bases, manage resources, and deploy a diverse array of customizable mechs in thrilling real-time battles. Master the art of war and dominate the battlefield.
* 16 Unique Mech Combinations: Unleash devastating firepower with a wide selection of mechs, each boasting unique strengths and abilities. Experiment with different combinations to find the perfect strategy for every scenario.
* Stylized 3D Graphics: Immerse yourself in the futuristic world of MechCom 3 with beautifully stylized 3D graphics. Witness epic battles unfold in breathtaking detail.
* Intuitive Controls: Command your forces with ease thanks to a streamlined and intuitive control scheme designed for mobile RTS. Focus on strategy, not fiddling with controls.
* Challenging AI Opponents: Test your tactical skills against cunning AI opponents that will push you to your limits. Hone your strategies and become a master commander.
* Multiple Game Modes: Explore various game modes offering diverse challenges and replayability. Experience the full spectrum of RTS gameplay.
* Premium RTS Experience: Enjoy an ad-free and IAP-free experience. Focus solely on conquering the Sigma Galaxy without distractions.

Download MechCom 3 now and experience the next generation of mobile RTS! The Sigma Galaxy awaits your command.
